source: The location of a font file is an implementation detail rather than a stable URL contract, so this may change again. If you have hard-coded {0} anywhere (a CDN rule, a CSP directive, a cache header, a test), point it at your build assets directory instead. Fonts are still served from {1} in development and with the webpack and rspack builders; see {2}where fonts are served from{/2}.

In der Entwicklung sowie mit den Buildern webpack und rspack werden Schriften weiterhin von {1} ausgeliefert; siehe {2}woher Schriften ausgeliefert werden{/2}.
